listen_address.description: IP address the IPP service listens on (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only, or 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: Port number to listen on for IPP traffic.

network_access.description: Whether to accept IPP connections from remote clients (not just localhost).

admin_access.description: Whether to allow remote administrative operations via IPP.

browsing_enabled.description: Whether to broadcast and discover printers via IPP (enables Browsing On/Off).

max_job_time.description: Maximum time (in seconds) a job may remain queued before being automatically canceled.

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of jobs (active + completed) to retain in the job history.

log_level.description: Verbosity of error logs; recommended for production: 'warn' or 'error'.

log_file.description: Path to the error log file. If empty, defaults to /var/log/cups/ipp_error_log.

access_log_file.description: Path to the access log file. If empty, defaults to /var/log/cups/ipp_access_log.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS (IPP over TLS) for encrypted communication.

access_rules.description: Ordered list of allow/deny rules for network access control.

action.description: Whether to allow or deny access for this rule.

source.description: Source IP address, CIDR subnet (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24), or '*' for all.

dns_sd_enabled.description: Enable DNS-SD service announcements for printer discovery on the local network.

dns_sd_service_name.description: Optional custom DNS-SD service name (e.g., 'MyIPPDevice'). If empty, defaults to hostname.

default.name: MediaType
default.description: Default media type for new jobs

default_printer_options.description: Default IPP attributes applied to print jobs unless overridden by client.

value.description: Value to assign (must be valid for the attribute).

max_request_size_kb.description: Maximum HTTP request body size (in kilobytes) to prevent denial-of-service via large payloads.
